## What & why

What does this change do, and why is it needed?

## How it was tested

How did you verify the change? Include commands run and/or the `designfit_validate` input/output you checked against.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` is green
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Docs updated if needed (README, SKILL.md, CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] Changes are focused and use conventional-commit-style messages
